facts.fact: The Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 is in force; its section 49 makes non-compliance with Commission orders an offence punishable by a fine or up to a year in prison.
The Nigeria Data Protection Commission, led by National Commissioner Dr Vincent Olatunji, enforces the Act.
The Commission fined Meta USD 32.8 million and issued enforcement orders under the Act in a Final Order, later set aside by a consent judgment.
The Commission dropped the USD 32.8 million fine against Meta in a consent judgment entered on 3 November 2025, and the article says Meta paid no penalty.
